title: 第25章 皇子亲临第26章 金刚经一部
slug: 长生从守书阁的太监开始
lines: “三哥三哥？你累不累啊，妹妹给你捶捶腿，三哥，三哥，你困不困啊，妹妹给你揉揉肩~”
一整个下午，毓庆宫中读书的三皇子睿亲王姬昭都不得安宁，妹妹一直像一只蚊子一样在他身周嗡嗡作响。
不停地“嘘寒问暖”，让他一直无法专心读书
终于。
啪！
“小七，你到底要干什么？”
姬昭简直快要被气笑了，将手中的书卷往桌子上一拍，有些不耐烦地问道。
莲公主的眼睛笑成了月牙状，手中捏着裙角。
“那个三哥，你一直在这里，不是读书就是修炼，不累吗？不会觉得无聊吗？”
“我觉得还好啊，书中自有颜如玉，书中自有黄金屋。”
见他这种态度，莲公主顿时有些泄气。
“三哥你真是越长大越无趣了！”
“那怎样才算是有趣啊？”
“当然是算了。”
就在这时，五皇子姬昙顶着一个青紫色的眼圈就走了进来，龙行虎步，风风火火。
“三哥，三哥，你得赶紧帮我一块去报仇啊！”
“这是怎么回事？”
见到胞弟这副样子，饶是姬昭再好的脾气也不禁生气，当即问道。
“谁打的？”
“还能是谁？老四那个狗东西呗！我这副模样，他也不好受，两个眼圈全都是青紫！只会比我伤的更重！”
“干得好五哥，正好替三哥也报了他上午在书堂咄咄逼人的仇！”
姬昙立刻附和。
“可不是嘛，读了两本书就觉得自己牛的不行，不知道从哪里抄来的两句诗，在先生面前显摆，鼻孔朝天！”
“五哥，那你后面准备干什么？不会和和三哥一样就在书房读书吧？那也太无聊了。”
姬昙想了想，又看了看三皇子的书桌，认可地点头。
“那你想怎么样？”
莲公主随即说道。
“我知道一个地方，还挺有趣的。”
姬昭一听到这句话，瞬间明白了什么。
这就是小七一直安分不下来的原因吗？
说起来也是，距离上次母后训斥她已经过去半月有余了。
对于她这样的跳脱性子来说，确实难熬。
最奇怪的是，以往小七即便是对什么东西有兴趣，往往也不过是三分钟热度，这次竟然足足过了一个月还念念不忘
这小太监还真是有两份本事。
姬昭现在也对这个只在档案上见过的小太监生出两分兴趣，一个精通《清静经》的小太监，一个流民出身的小太监，一个书阁之中整日埋首书山经海的小太监，到底哪一个才是真实的你呢？
不过姬昙还是不明所以。
“什么地方？”
“书阁啊。”
“书阁？”
content_en:
"Third brother, third brother? Are you tired? My sister will give you a leg rub. Third brother, third brother, are you sleepy? My sister will rub your shoulders~"
Throughout the afternoon, the third prince, Prince Rui, Ji Zhao, who was studying in the Yuqing Palace, could not rest peacefully. His sister kept buzzing around him like a mosquito.
Constantly asking for help made him unable to concentrate on his studies
Finally.
Snap!
"Xiao Qi, what on earth are you going to do?"
Ji Zhao almost laughed out of anger. He slapped the book in his hand on the table and asked impatiently.
Princess Lian's eyes turned into crescents when she smiled, and she held the corner of her skirt in her hands.
"Third brother, you've been here all the time, either studying or practicing. Aren't you tired? Don't you feel bored?"
"I think it's okay. The book has its own Yan Ruyu, and the book has its own golden house."
Seeing his attitude, Princess Lian suddenly felt a little discouraged.
"Third brother, you are becoming more and more boring as you grow older!"
"Then what's fun?"
"Of course forget it."
At this moment, the fifth prince Ji Tan walked in with purple circles under his eyes, walking like a dragon and a tiger in a hurry.
"Third brother, third brother, you have to help me get revenge quickly!"
"What's going on?"
Seeing his brother like this, Ji Zhao couldn't help but get angry no matter how good-tempered he was, and asked immediately.
"Who hit me?"
"Who else could it be? That bitch, the Fourth Brother! It's hard for him to feel like I'm like this, with both eye circles covered in bruises! He'll only be injured more seriously than me!"
"Well done, fifth brother, you just happened to avenge third brother for his aggressive behavior in the study hall this morning!"
Ji Tan immediately agreed.
"Isn't that right? After reading two books, I felt that I was really good. I copied two lines of poetry from who knows where and showed them off in front of my husband with my nostrils in the sky!"
"Fifth brother, what are you going to do next? You won't just study in the study like third brother, right? That would be too boring."
Ji Tan thought for a while, then looked at the third prince's desk, and nodded in approval.
"What do you want?"
Princess Lian said immediately.
"I know a place that's quite interesting."
As soon as Ji Zhao heard this sentence, he understood something instantly.
Is this the reason why Xiao Qi has been unable to settle down?
Speaking of which, it had been more than half a month since the last time her mother had scolded her.
It's really hard for someone with such an out-of-touch temperament like her.
The strangest thing is that in the past, even if Xiao Qi was interested in something, it would only last for three minutes. This time, it took a full month and she still couldn't forget it.
This little eunuch really has two abilities.
Ji Zhao now also has two interests in this little eunuch whom he has only seen in files. A little eunuch who is proficient in the "Qing Jing Sutra", a little eunuch who is a refugee, and a little eunuch who spends all his time in the bookstore burying his head in the book. Which one is the real you?
But Ji Tan still doesn't know why.
"Where?"
"Bookstore."
"Bookstore?"
